comparison_rules: All candidate-bound evidence must identify the exact candidate SHA.
Every scope region must be CLEAR in weights-only acceptance before final corrective anatomy can pass.
Every scope coupling system must be CLEAR in candidate coupling evidence.
Every scope defect must be closed with closure evidence or the candidate is not engineering-clear.
Motion continuity is report-only and therefore requires explicit engineering review PASS rather than an invented threshold.
Regression, contact where applicable, visual engineering review and change audit must pass.
No new open Critical/High defect may appear relative to the parent blocker set.
Owner review remains separate; engineering clearance never implies production approval.
